name: Speaker in a floating window, headline or dialogue above
description: The speaker's full-frame video smoothly shrinks into a floating rounded window (white rim, soft shadow, framed on the face) over the lower part of a clean background, then grows back to full frame at the end, so it flows in and out of the plain footage. Above the window: either a big condensed headline with an optional small label and an orange highlighted word, or up to three speech bubbles that pop in one by one (quoted dialogue, with a small name tag). An optional emoji sticker pops on the window's corner.
use_when: The speaker keeps talking but the line deserves a visual frame: a quoted exchange ('he asked: how many rotis?', 'I said ten'), a topic title, a question to the viewer, a reaction. Keeps the face on screen (unlike full-screen mockups) and avoids the squeezed look.

headline.help: big title above the window, 2-6 words; '' when using bubbles

kicker.help: small spaced label above the headline, e.g. 'EVERY DAY'

highlight.help: word(s) of the headline set on an orange box

bubbles.help: [{from: 'them'|'me', text, name, at}] speech bubbles in order; text <= 40 characters; name is a small tag on 'them' bubbles ('COOK'); at = seconds from the scene start (default: spread out)

sticker.help: one emoji that pops on the window's top-right corner, e.g. '🤯' or '😂'

morph_in.help: start full-frame and shrink into the window (use when the previous shot is the plain speaker)

morph_out.help: grow back to full frame at the end (use when the next shot is the plain speaker)
